title: Build, Evaluate, and Explain the Capstone
core_invariant: The capstone is a WP-136 curriculum package on the frozen generic runtime, not a one-off app and not a custom frontend. Assemble retrieval, memory, tools, inference, and the M40 eval suite behind M41 contracts. Predict before executing. Degrade rather than crash. Defend production readiness with evidence. Transfer without assistance.

stages.title: Frame the capstone as a WP-136 package, not a one-off app
stages.instructions: Read the M42 invariant: this capstone is a WP-136 curriculum package composed from the WP-121 catalogue on the frozen generic runtime. It is not a one-off app, not a custom Mission Player, and not a special platform route. Consume M01-M41 components, m40.eval.v1, and M41 contracts. Identify gate evidence: an end-to-end orchestrator trace, an M40 suite report, a failure-degradation matrix, and a capstone ADR. Generic WP-137 metric, table, and trace blocks render on the generic workbench. No custom frontend.

stages.title: Trace the orchestrator loop and defense evaluation
stages.instructions: Read CapstoneSystemOrchestrator.execute_capstone_task and run_defense_evaluation without running them. Record how retrieval, model, tool, memory, and evaluation components register; where latency versus ObservabilityBudget selects FALLBACK_CACHED; how memory is appended only on the full-capability path; and which fields the defense report aggregates. Predict full-capability versus degraded outputs for one query before execution. Do not look for a dedicated capstone application process.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Trace names component registry, budget-driven degradation, and defense-report fields.

stages.title: Predict, then run one end-to-end capstone query
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle on the generic runtime. (1) PREDICT the full-capability path for a retrieval-plus-tool query under budget, and the degraded cached fallback when simulated latency exceeds max_latency_ms. (2) COMMIT the prediction so it cannot be edited. (3) EXECUTE / RUN the orchestrator; emit WP-137 metric, table, and trace blocks. (4) OBSERVE status, eval_score, degradation_applied, memory_depth, and active components. (5) SUBMIT / EXPLAIN any delta. Reuse m40.eval.v1 constraints; do not invent a one-off scoring UI. This remains a catalogue experiment stage.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; full-capability and degraded paths are both observed as WP-137 blocks.

stages.title: Diagnose timeout, overflow, and eval-gate failure
stages.instructions: Three injected faults, one named change each. Context-window overflow: truncate oldest conversation history while preserving system instructions. Tool execution timeout: abort a hanging tool after the 500ms SLA and return a degraded response. Evaluation gate failure: reject deployment when the M40 canonical slice gate fails even if the average score is high. Predict, execute, emit a WP-137 table of fault versus action versus eval_version, and repair the orchestrator policy not the M40 pack.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Each fault names one controlled cause, the degradation or reject action, and reuse of m40.eval.v1.

stages.title: Defend production readiness without assistance
stages.instructions: Without AI-generated code, explain the trade-off between aggressive caching and retrieval freshness, outline the four graceful-degradation stages from M41, and decide whether a high average with one critical citation miss may ship. Produce a blank-page defense that cites M40 slice gates and M41 trust-boundary enforcement. Do not build a separate capstone application.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Unassisted defense names degradation hierarchy, eval reuse, and a named ship/no-ship rule.

stages.title: Defend V12 production readiness
stages.instructions: Author ADR-42 for Flagship V12. Decide end-to-end pipeline architecture, observability and SLA enforcement, and how empirical M40 evaluation plus M41 contracts justify production readiness. Reject a one-off app, a custom frontend, and mission-id platform conditionals. Record owner, status, date, and a revisit condition.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: ADR defends V12 as a WP-136 package on the generic runtime and records a revisit condition.

stages.title: Tag Flagship V12 on the generic runtime
stages.instructions: Explain how M42 releases V12 Integrated AI Systems Capstone: structured and unstructured data, retrieval, tools, evals, and observability composed as catalogue stages. The generic Mission Player loads this WP-136 package. There is no capstone-only binary, no custom workbench, and no special /m42 route. Learner evidence remains unfilled in the repository.

stages.title: Evaluate capstone evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate orientation, experiment, controlled-failure, transfer, and ADR evidence against the gate contract. Issue PASSED or a targeted repair plan. Do not award completion from a one-off demo or from a high average that hides a critical slice.
